text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: HIGH - customer=Orchid (orchid-corp) VPC pool 'orchid-vpc-pool-3' reporting spike in 5xx and partial KV cache misses on seq_model_v2. 5xx rate -> 6.2% in last 5m. paging @rick_oncall and @dave_sre

rick_oncall: grabbing. seeing CPU on the pool nodes spike and one pod OOMKilled ~3m ago. starting triage.

elena_prodeng: tagging in model infra folks. can we confirm whether this is model-level error (nan/inf) or infra timeouts?

maya_se: Orchid is on Dedicated + VPC, SLA 99.95. customer impact: intermittent generation failures for heavy-batched inference paths (batch size > 8). CS notified. @amanda_cs prepping message.

amanda_cs: on it. drafting: "We may perform a temporary safe-swap to a fallback variant to preserve availability while we investigate. Expect brief change in latency/quality." will share before sending.

rick_oncall: quick checks: 
```
kubectl -n dedicated-orchid get pods -l app=orchid-infer -o wide
kubectl -n dedicated-orchid logs orchid-infer-2 | tail -n 120
```
seeing repeated `AllocatorOOM` and `cublas` timeouts. Also some `kv cache miss` traces but not primary.

dave_sre: rolling metrics show model seq_model_v2 token error rates correlate with GPU memory pressure. suspect a recent weight checkpoint (2026-02-12) triggered larger working set.

josh_platform: we have an ephemeral alias mechanism we can use to route traffic off the problematic variant. propose 'safeswap' flow: create ephemeral alias -> route X% traffic -> monitor -> full shift.

elena_prodeng: agree. recommend safe variant = `seq_model_v1-quant-safe` (lower mem, slightly older weights) as temporary target. Also suggest enabling circuit-breaker for large batches on the tenant (max_batch_size=8) to reduce pressure.

rick_oncall: initiating safeswap. claiming incident. running command to apply policy: 
```
# apply tenant routing override
redwoodctl routing override create --tenant orchid --alias orchid-ephemeral-safeswap --target seq_model_v1-quant-safe --rollout gradual --steps 10,30,60,100 --monitor metrics:5xx_rate,latency_p95 --expires 30m
```

ops_bot: routing override created (id=rov-8675309). current state: step=0/4. monitoring hook enabled. alerts re-targeted to incident channel.

maya_se: flagged for customer: if quality regressions >3% on eval set, we will roll back. else we will keep fallback until patch deploy.

amanda_cs: sent ETA note to Orchid support alias: "We’ve detected transient GPU pressure causing generation errors. We are routing a small portion of traffic to a safe variant to maintain availability while we investigate. No data exfiltration. Will update every 15m." Customer acknowledged.

rick_oncall: starting gradual shift now. controllers show 10% traffic -> OK. monitoring: 5xx dropped from 6.2% to 4.1% after step 1. latency +20ms p95 on swapped requests.

10m later - rick_oncall: step 2 (30%) applied. 5xx -> 2.2%. no additional OOM events.

elena_prodeng: ops note: preparing a compacted checkpoint build (reduce activation caching) to reduce memory pressure; will push a canary to single pod in pool in 25m. required tenant config change: `activation_cache=false` for canary.

dave_sre: enabling batch size cap on Orchid routing: `max_batch_size=8` enforced at edge. applying now.

ops_bot: batch cap applied. some queued requests now split. observability: token throughput unchanged, GPU utilization down ~12%.

rick_oncall: step 3 (60%) completed. 5xx 0.9%. can hold.

amanda_cs: customer updates: Orchid wants a timeline before full switch. advising that we can keep fallback for up to 2 hours while we validate reduced-checkpoint.

josh_platform: pushed build `seq_model_v2:2026-02-12-patched` to canary (1 pod). monitoring heap and cublas ops.

elena_prodeng: canary looks good for 15m: no OOM, no cublas timeouts. plan: if stable for 30m, we will flip traffic back using reverse safeswap.

rick_oncall: preparing reverse plan: 
```
# reverse safeswap plan
redwoodctl routing override update --id rov-8675309 --rollout reverse-gradual --steps 10,30,60,100 --monitor metrics:5xx_rate,latency_p95 --precondition canary=healthy
```

amanda_cs: communicating to customer: possible brief quality regression windows during swap, asking for green light to proceed when canary healthy for 30m.

orchid-support (customer message copied by Amanda): "Thanks team. Please proceed once canary stable. We prefer minimal quality variance but uptime is priority."

rick_oncall: canary stable 30m ✅. initiating reverse safeswap. step1 10% -> monitoring.

ops_bot: reverse rollout progressing. step2 30% -> no regressions, 5xx remains <0.5%.

dave_sre: after full reverse (100%) complete, we'll remove the routing override and add a safe-variant policy to tenant profile to auto-fail to quantized variant if OOM pattern recurs. proposed tenant policy snippet: 
```
{
  "tenant": "orchid",
  "on_error": "safeswap",
  "safe_variant": "seq_model_v1-quant-safe",
  "trigger": {"5xx_rate": ">0.5%", "oom_count": ">=1"},
  "rate_limit": {"max_batch_size": 8}
}
```

elena_prodeng: also adding a model pin for the patched weight: `seq_model_v2:2026-02-12-patched` and marking `seq_model_v2:2026-02-12` as deprecated for Orchid tenant.

ops_bot: reverse rollout complete. traffic fully on patched `seq_model_v2:2026-02-12-patched`. routing override rov-8675309 removed.

rick_oncall: confirming metrics stable: 5xx <0.2%, p95 latency back to baseline. no further OOMs. closing incident in 10m after postmortem queued.

amanda_cs: customer notif: "Issue mitigated. We’ve reverted to patched weights and will keep safeguards in place. PM will follow up with root cause and timeline for permanent fix." Orchid acknowledged and appreciates the quick response.

dave_sre: postmortem owners: @elena_prodeng, @rick_oncall, @josh_platform. draft due EOD tomorrow. tagging incident severity: Sev3 (customer visible but no SLA breach after mitigation).

ops_bot: incident closed by rick_oncall at ts=1755554578.

rick_oncall: quick lessons: add automated preflight for large checkpoints that estimates additional activation memory; consider async activation spill to CPU for edge cases.

elena_prodeng: noted. will file infra task and precert gating for future model uploads.

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x7, :eyes: x3)
